jobs.occupation: General Manager - Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Diamond Slice — General Manager (Fuldtid / Full-time)

Arbejdssted / Location: Blågårds Plads & Tagensvej, 2200 København N

Stillingstype / Position: Fastansættelse, fuldtid / Permanent, full-time

Ansøgningsfrist / Deadline: Snarest muligt / As soon as possible

Sprog / Languages: Dansk & Engelsk (se nedenfor / see English version below)

DANSK VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Trives du i en tempofyldt gæstfrihedskultur, elsker du surdejspizza på højeste niveau, og har du den operationelle rygrad til at drive et hurtigtvoksende restaurantbrand?

Siden åbningen på Blågårds Plads har Diamond Slice redefineret New York-style pizza i København. Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Nøgleområder og ansvarsopgaver

• 
Forretningsdrift & systemer:

• 
Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

• 
Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

• 
Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

• 
Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

• 
FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

• 
Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

• 
Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

• 
Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

• 
Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

• 
Catering, festivaler & vækst:

• 
Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

• 
Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

• 
Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

• 
Økonomistyring & rapportering:

• 
Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

• 
Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

• 
Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

• 
Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

• 
Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

• 
Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

• 
Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

• 
En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

• 
Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

• 
En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

• 
En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

• 
Business Operations & Systems:

• 
Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

• 
Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

• 
Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

• 
Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

• 
FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

• 
Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

• 
Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

• 
Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

• 
Catering, Festivals & Growth:

• 
Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

• 
Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

• 
Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

• 
Financial Control & Reporting:

• 
Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

• 
Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

• 
Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

• 
Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

• 
Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

• 
Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

• 
A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

• 
Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

• 
A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

• 
Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

• 
A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

jobs.occupation: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & TechnologyDepartment of Food ScienceFaculty of ScienceUniversity of CopenhagenThe Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

• 
Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

• 
How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

• 
Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

• 
Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

• 
Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

 In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.Tenure-track assistant professorThe tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.Associate professor and full professorApplicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising meritGeneral criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.Please read more here:For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdfFor associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdfFor professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdfApplicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact hereThe tenure-track assistant programmeThe tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.Salary and employment conditionsThe position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad.Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).Filing of applicationThe position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include 

• 
Curriculum vitae including:

• 
Please describe and document international network and relations

• 
Please describe and document internationally based activities

• 
Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark

• 
Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media

• 
Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.

• 
Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

• 
Research plan - description of current and future research plans

Opportunities for professional and personal development

Salary based on experience and qualifications

Employment on ordinary Danish terms

About the position

We are looking for practical and reliable employees to carry out paving and landscaping construction work in Denmark.

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

Instead, we value practical experience, a good understanding of manual work, accuracy, reliability and the ability to learn new working methods.

•

Cutting and adapting paving materials

Establishing and adjusting edges, levels and gradients

Minor landscaping and groundworks

Using hand tools and small construction machinery

General maintenance and cleaning of the work area

Is comfortable with physically demanding work

Works accurately and takes pride in the quality of their work

• 
Can work independently based on instructions

• 
Works well as part of a team

Is reliable, punctual and responsible

Is motivated to learn and develop practical skills

Language requirements

English is an advantage.

Danish is not required at the time of employment. However, the employee must be able to understand relevant work instructions and health and safety instructions sufficiently to perform the work safely.

Salary and employment conditions

DKK 37,500 gross per month for 37 hours of work per week.

In addition, the employer provides an occupational pension in accordance with the applicable employment terms.

The fixed cash salary corresponds to your qualifications

Permanent full-time employment in Denmark

37-hour working week

• 
Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

• 
Training and introduction to the company's working methods

• 
Varied projects within paving and landscaping construction

• 
A professional working environment

Opportunity to develop practical and manual skills

jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. Your working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.     Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges:We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.  We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :  one based in Mobile (USA)  one based in Bangalore (India) The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.  Your main tasks and responsibilities are: Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).   Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.   Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).  This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.  Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. Your boarding pass:You have an advanced level in English.  You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. You have structure and systems skills.  You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.  You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.  You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.  Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.  Take your career to a new level and apply online now! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Ingénieur en certification et navigabilité   (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Service de certification des réparations basé à Toulouse, France . Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion. Votre environnement de travail :Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !
